purpose: Teach: 精神病/思索/低温/男系/蛋白/環状/中等/疑似

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の精神病に対する偏見をなくせ
lines.en: Our company needs to eliminate the stigma around mental health in our staff.
lines.style: Authoritative, measured delivery. Clear articulation on each clause. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who has thought this through. No performance, pure direction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営判断には深い思索を加えます
lines.en: Understood. We'll bring deeper strategic thinking to management decisions.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Slight nod on the opening word. Steady, professional pace. Each commitment lands clearly. The assurance of someone taking mental notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、低温物流の体制を強化しろ
lines.en: Our company needs to strengthen our cold-chain logistics infrastructure.
lines.style: Direct and purposeful. Deliberate pace on key terms. No softening. The voice of someone moving to the next priority with equal weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業家の男系継承にこだわりません
lines.en: Understood. We're not bound to male-line succession in the founding family structure.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. No hesitation. The flatness of a significant policy shift stated as fact, not debate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、蛋白質関連の食品事業を強化しろ
lines.en: Our company needs to strengthen our protein-related food business.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. Slight emphasis on growth. The voice of strategic focus. Not rushed, not theatrical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の流通環状経路を最適化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll optimize the distribution pathways for product circulation.
lines.style: Efficient, professional. Crisp word boundaries. The rhythm of someone confirming and moving forward. No embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中等規模の取引先を大切にしろ
lines.en: Our company needs to value mid-sized business partners more deliberately.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the authority. Slight softening on 'value.' The voice of someone balancing strategy with human consideration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。疑似広告にならない表現を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. We'll ensure all communications avoid anything that appears like disguised advertising.
lines.style: Conclusive. Solid landing on the final commitment. The voice of someone closing out a list. Professional, complete, ready to move.
